interpretationLocks: The solid line is explicitly an approximate drawing of the widest extent, not a surveyed boundary.
The dashed line denotes territories temporarily attached and must not be merged into the widest-extent line.
A visible settlement is an anchor candidate only; it is not a polygon vertex.
The figure is not date-specific to 1326-04-07.
No pixel-to-geographic correspondence is asserted by this observation alone.
No polygon, ring, or MapBin output is created.

required: retained source artifact or immutable reviewable artifact identity
independently sourced geographic coordinates for selected anchors
